name: uses the specified stable byte hash independent of server order
input: one ASCII prompt and the same server IDs in two orders
test:
servers = ['gpu-a', 'gpu-b', 'gpu-c']
assert route_prompt_by_affinity('summarize this note', servers) == 'gpu-b'
assert route_prompt_by_affinity('summarize this note', list(reversed(servers))) == 'gpu-b'

name: hashes UTF-8 prompt bytes rather than Python object identity
input: a Unicode prompt and three server IDs
test:
assert route_prompt_by_affinity('分析一下', ['east', 'west', 'north']) == 'north'
assert route_prompt_by_affinity('', ['one']) == 'one'

name: validates the prompt and server collection
input: empty, duplicate, and non-string server IDs
test:
def expect(exception_type, call):
    try:
        call()
    except exception_type:
        return
    raise AssertionError(f'expected {exception_type.__name__}')

expect(TypeError, lambda: route_prompt_by_affinity(7, ['a']))
expect(ValueError, lambda: route_prompt_by_affinity('x', []))
expect(ValueError, lambda: route_prompt_by_affinity('x', ['a', 'a']))
expect(ValueError, lambda: route_prompt_by_affinity('x', ['']))
expect(TypeError, lambda: route_prompt_by_affinity('x', ['a', 2]))
